\begin{example} \end{example}[Integrable zeroth-order coefficient] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0175 1. ch12:12.11\group Weak Scalar Maximum Principles

The conclusion of Theorem 1.3 remains true with $A/\sqrt t$ replaced by any integrable function $\alpha :(0,T]\to \mathbb R$. \end{example}

Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:complete-manifold-scalar-wmp-barrier Replace $u$ by $\exp (-\int _0^t\alpha (s)\, ds)u$. The new function has no positive zeroth-order term and the same spatial growth, so the barrier argument in Theorem 1.3 applies verbatim.
